beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Tellurium in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Franz-Joseph Müller von Reichenstein found that Transylvanian gold ores did not behave like antimony, and his sample waited years for a full answer.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Tellurium in this catalog?

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Tellurium in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Chemists who take in even a little tellurium can develop a garlic odor on the breath that lingers long after they leave the bench.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Tellurium in this catalog?
